title: Account of a Tic Tac-type craft over Pennsylvania in 1967

tellings.quote: In the book we're going to give you, there's a a very good account of it from 1967 over Pennsylvania,

tellings.difference: Names the book as Disclosure: An Illustrated History, and does not mention the Tic Tac shape.
tellings.link_reason: Both are the 1967 Pennsylvania account in the book Greer is giving away.

plain: In 1967, a craft shaped like a Tic Tac, a white oval like the mint, was seen over Pennsylvania. Steven Greer, a doctor who founded a group pressing for the release of UFO secrets, tells Jesse Michels there is a good account of it in a book he is giving him. He names the book as Disclosure: An Illustrated History, and when he mentions the 1967 Pennsylvania case again he does not describe the shape. If true, it would mean craft like the ones Navy pilots later reported were being seen decades earlier.
